notes.title: Update v 0.9.5.0: Fixes and stuff.
notes.content:
Hello people, it's been a while. Happy new year!

So what happened in the last months. We tried making Moribund Online. Aaaand it didn't work. There's several reason's we can't make Moribund online with our resources. That's why we have been looking around for a publisher. We prefer having a good local multiplayer game than online bad one.

We will be also attending the Indie Prize Showcase at Berlin 5 - 7 Feb. If you are in the showcase come by our table and try beating us (You got NO chance).

Now regarding the update here's what's included.

- Redesigned all the characters in the battle so they are more distinct from one another and from the background.
- Bug fixes and optimization.
- Some aesthetical improvements on all the levels.
- Crouching now forbids the player from jumping.

As you can see the price went up to 9.99! Yay! As we had mentioned when the Early Access came live this was scheduled. Within the next month or so the game will reach all the promised features (80 levels, 1 more mode) and there will also be some single player features.

If you got any feedback for us now is the time to tell us!

Thank you all!

notes.title: Update v 0.9.4.0: New Mountain Levels and plenty more!
notes.content:
Hey there guys. Plenty of stuff were added, here's the list:
[*][b]New setting (The Mountains) [/b]. Which means 10 new levels, 2 new stage mechanics and a new music track.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25704317/99be6388b554a3cc00f9c5e4fda0774fb4090169.jpg[/img]
[*]We added a short 2-part [b]tutorial mode [/b]that can be played be played with multiple players.
[*][b]New player action: The Knockback.[/b] It's a short range attack that does no damage but knocks the enemy back.
Now this action is incredibly hard to apply effectively but it can give some edge to those who master it. A few uses would be:
   ~ Knocking an enemy on a trap
   ~ Knocking an enemy off an advantageous position
   ~ Getting some distance from an enemy in case you’re out of spores
Remember. Hard to master, don't spam it. (It's on B for the Xbox controller, O for PS controller)
[*]We increased the spore reload rate for the blue power-up. Now spores replenish 3 times faster instead 2.
[*]Added 9 new achievements around the new mechanics and levels.
[*]We made some gameplay and aesthetical improvements in almost all levels.
[*]Added the option to change the point goal (You can choose now if a game ends at 6, 8, 10 or 12 points)
[*]Several bug fixes and optimizations

Ah one more thing. We need your feedback. So far we have been listening to those who had some notes, but we can never have enough. Until now our most requested feature was online or bots. [u]We decided to take a shot on online. Now we can’t make any promises. We just say we’re looking into it.[/u] This will probably prolong (a little) the Early Access but I think you guys agree it’s going to be worth it. We’ll be keeping you posted.

notes.title: Hotfix v 0.9.3.1
notes.content:
We made a couple of fixes and additions:
~ Bouncing spores now don't target your teammates in Team Battle
~ Bouncing Clusters no longer collide with the players' tentacles
~ Bouncing Clusters now have a spawn limit
~ Keyboard Controls were changed
~ Explosion radius is now 15% larger
~ Various bug fixes and optimizations
